mutant.description: Three mutants, each a monkeypatch inside the offline tests. Arm 8 replaces guard_decision with an always-PASS guard; arm 3's READ_FAILED stop must then NOT read SKIPPED_GUARD. Arm 9 replaces allowed_moves with an always-allowed check; arm 2's thesis_summary move must then NOT read SKIPPED_ALLOWED. Arm 11 replaces today_block_missing with an always-False check; arm 4b's old-block case must then NOT read NO_TODAY_MODEL_BLOCK.
mutant.expected: each mutant arm asserts that the stop, skip or stale-block label does not occur under the mutant (the arm expectation fails under the mutant)
mutant.observed: arm 8 under always-PASS guard: READ_FAILED case status WRITTEN, write_one called once; arm 9 under disabled allowed check: thesis_summary case status WRITTEN, write_one called once; arm 11 under disabled today check: old-block case status WRITTEN, write_one called once; 25 passed

determinism.method: the offline test file run twice with the same input, comparing the summary line
determinism.observed: 25 passed in 1.34s and 25 passed in 1.06s; the dry-run output is not compared for determinism because the real bucket is live (the census line is a measurement at a time, not a function of the input)

declared_exclusions.reason: The order's write grant is the driver, its test, the deliverables folder and the channel; the KPI-census file was supplied to the worktree by the issuer and is not edited.

declared_exclusions.reason: Forbidden by the order's preflight; the dry run uses only the bucket's read operations through a read-only client.

surprises: AMGT_HARVST-D1-W179-S1: HVST-cn-1 premise: the worktree's sparse checkout omitted org/tier1_exec/, so every dossier build raised FileNotFoundError on the KPI-census file (first dry run errors=95); the issuer added the folder and the re-run measured errors=0.
AMGT_HARVST-D1-W179-S2: HVST-cn-1 status gap: no order status for a name with no stored dossier; the driver reports SKIPPED_ALLOWED with reason no-stored-dossier. No such name in the 95-name run.

AMGT_HARVST-D1-W179-S3: HVST-cn-1 status precedence: the order does not rank NO_NEW_MODEL_BLOCK against an allowed fund_form move; the driver ranks NO_NEW first. No NO_NEW row in the measured run. Ruled by the issuer: keep.

AMGT_HARVST-D1-W179-S4: HVST-cn-1 trading-day gate: the order names no zone; --require-trading-day read the UTC date. Ruled by the issuer under amendment 1: the America/New_York date of the run's clock, now implemented with a test.

AMGT_HARVST-D1-W179-S5: HVST-cn-1 dry-run finding: BP_LN_Equity is WOULD_WRITE (guard PASS, model_rows moved), not NO_NEW_MODEL_BLOCK or UNCHANGED as the order expected. Ruled by the issuer: correct, the order's expectation was wrong.

AMGT_HARVST-D1-W179-S6: HVST-cn-1 amendment 1 placement: NO_TODAY_MODEL_BLOCK is ranked after the guard (a guard STOP reads SKIPPED_GUARD), which the amendment does not state; both skip and write nothing.

AMGT_HARVST-D1-W179-S7: HVST-cn-1 amendment 1 gap: a name with no readable model block (guard ABSENT or READ_FAILED) is not NO_TODAY in the driver and is left to the guard; no such name in the measured run.
